Title: Incoherent severity
Description: Indicates a mismatch in the  different severity levels found in the same log line.
Output: Boolean, as it is either consistent or not

Title: Email
Description: Indicates presence of an email address in a log line. Email addresses are considered personally identifiable information (PII) and should not be logged.
Output: A nullable list of detected PII types (EMAIL, CARD, etc.) or a vector of boolean

Title: Name
Description: Indicates presence of a proper name in a log line. A proper name can be a person, city or country name. Proper names are considered personally identifiable information (PII) and should not be logged.

Title: UUID
Description: Indicates presence of a UUID (Unique User Identifier) in a log line. UUIDs are considered personally identifiable information (PII) and should not be logged.

Title: Postal address
Description: Indicates presence of a street address in a log line. Street addresses are considered personally identifiable information (PII) and should not be logged.

Title: Payment card number
Description: Indicates presence of a credit or debit card number in a log line. Card numbers are considered personally identifiable information (PII) and should not be logged.

Title: Postal code
Description: Indicates presence of a postal code in a log line. Postal codes are considered sensitive information and should not be logged.

Title: Phone number
Description: Indicates presence of a phone number in a log line. Phone numbers are considered sensitive information and should not be logged.

Title: IP address
Description: Indicates presence of an IPv4 or IPV6 address in a log line. IPs are considered sensitive information and should not be logged.

Title: Geo coordinates
Description: Indicates presence of geolocation information in a log line. This comprises longitude and latitude. Geolocation data are considered sensitive information and should not be logged.

Title: IBAN account number
Description: Indicates presence of an International Bank Account Number (IBAN). IBANs are considered personally identifiable information (PII) and should not be logged.

Title: US bank account number
Description: Indicates presence of a US bank account number is between 8 to 17 digits. Bank accounts are considered personally identifiable information (PII) and should not be logged.

Title: US driving licence number
Description: Indicates presence of a US driver license number according to https://ntsi.com/drivers-license-format/. Driver licence numbers are considered personally identifiable information (PII) and should not be logged.

Title: US taxpayer ID
Description: Indicates presence of a US Individual Taxpayer Identification Number (ITIN). ITINs are considered personally identifiable information (PII) and should not be logged.

Title: US social security number
Description: Indicates presence of a US Social Security Number (SSN) with 9 digits. SSNs are considered personally identifiable information (PII) and should not be logged.

Title: Medical license number
Description: Indicates presence of a common medical license number. Medical licence numbers are considered personally identifiable information (PII) and should not be logged.

Title: US passport number
Description: Indicates presence of a US passport number (9 digits) in a log line. Passport numbers are considered personally identifiable information (PII) and should not be logged.

Title: Nationality, religion or politics
Description: Indicates presence of a person’s nationality, religious or political group. Those informations are considered sensitive information and should not be logged.

Title: Low message size
Description: Indicates that the log’s message  size is too small. This can point to a lack of descriptiveness of some log messages. Logs should provide a sufficiently rich yet concise contextual information to help with debugging or troubleshooting.
Output: A number, or a boolean if we compare it to a predefined value, or a nullable list of range types (10K_SIZE, 100K_SIZE, etc.)

Title: High message size
Description: Indicates that the log’s message  size is too large. This can be due to an excess of verbosity or to large data chunks present in the log line. Logs should provide a sufficiently rich yet concise contextual information to help with debugging or troubleshooting.

Title: Multiple languages - multiple lines
Description: Indicates presence of multiple languages in logs. A single language should be favored for logging messages to ease and maximize information recall when searching for logs.
Output: A list of detected language types (LANG_FR, LANG_ENG, etc.) or a nullable list of detected language issue types (MULTI_LANG)

Title: Multiples languages - same line
Description: Indicates presence of multiple languages in the same log line. A single language should be favored for logging messages to ease and maximize information recall when searching for logs.

Title: Lack of context
Description: Indicates lack of contextual variables in a log level. Logs should provide a sufficiently rich yet concise contextual information to help with debugging or troubleshooting.
Output: A nullable list of detected types (NO_CONTEXT, etc.)
